note: Defect areas are computed on the native-resolution ground-truth masks; the canonical evaluation grid coarsens them to 32x32 (and stride=8 to 56x56). Pixel AP is a ranking metric over the coarsened grid: a high AP shows the score ranks labelled defect cells above labelled normal cells on this set, it does not prove the score is the uniquely optimal ordering, nor that sub-grid-scale defects are resolved. Sample counts here equal the E2 prediction coverage, so AP is computed over the whole split.
